1.

Product Overview

Entrance systems built for high-traffic commercial premises — durable, secure and visually refined.

Commercial Doors are designed for offices, commercial buildings, retail spaces, hotels, hospitals, schools, showrooms and other high-traffic environments.

These doors provide a combination of durability, security, smooth operation and modern appearance, while meeting the functional requirements of commercial premises.

Available in glass, aluminium and steel configurations — manual or fully automatic — to suit the footfall, security level and design language of each building.

High Traffic

Engineered for continuous daily footfall.

Modern Appearance

Glass and aluminium finishes for a professional look.

Access Control

Compatible with card, keypad and security systems.

Configurations

Single leaf, double leaf and automatic sliding options.
